nodes.label: Morphology capability context
nodes.rationale: Morphology generates inflected Old English forms into canonical wyrdcraeft.sqlite3 and, since the July 2026 Wright catalog work, assigns each inflectable lemma a Wright class. Generation correctness follows ADR 0012: tests and historical grammar, not Perl as oracle. Verb generators are engines rather than Wright conjugation classes (ADR 0011). Wright paragraph text is a separate explicit ingest because build must not parse markdown. Legacy source wright fields are audit-only; lemma_morph_classes is the canonical classification. Morphology and dictionary share the canonical database and remain separate capabilities.

nodes.label: ADR 0011
nodes.rationale: Verb generators are engines, not Wright conjugation classes. Strong is ablaut; Weak covers Weak I/II derivation plus item-shape for Weak III, preterite-present, and anomalous; manual forms run first as a separate stage. ADR 0021 also cites ADR 0011 for refusing to put Strong/Weak on the facade constructor and for deleting compatibility aliases.

nodes.label: Wright morph-class catalog
nodes.rationale: Reference tables are seeded from wright_paradigms.json. LemmaMorphClassAssigner runs after paradigm assigners and before form generation, in priority order: paradigm or paraID, then POS features, then Wright section intersection at or above 330, otherwise skip. Generation-derived participles appended during verb generation are not assigned at build time because assignment has already run. forms.morph_class_id foreign-key propagation remains deferred.

nodes.label: Wright section text ingest
nodes.rationale: Paragraph text is not parsed during morphology build or dictionary build. Explicit ingest-wright-text commands upsert wright_sections.section_text so browse can read SQLite only. Bundled wright.md currently has phonology sections 1–58; inflection sections at 330 and above need a fuller markdown corpus. Dictionary and morphology each have their own ingest and audit commands.

nodes.label: WrightAuditService
nodes.rationale: The legacy audit compares bundled source wright fields to lemma_morph_classes and never rewrites source files. Exit code 0 in v1 because the command is report-only; canonical classification is the assignment table, not the legacy field.

nodes.label: Canonical wyrdcraeft.sqlite3
nodes.rationale: Morphology and dictionary default to app-data wyrdcraeft.sqlite3, which holds forms, morph-catalog tables, lemma_morph_classes, and attached bt_* tables. Tests must use isolated app data or an explicit temp path. Settings app-data overrides move this location.

nodes.label: Plan: morph-class browse and audit
nodes.rationale: Browse dictionary detail joins morph class at read time through LexiconQueryService and LexiconBrowseApp, shows Unclassified when there is no assignment, and opens stored Wright section text in a modal without parsing markdown at runtime.

nodes.label: Wright catalog phase 3: forms link and query
nodes.rationale: Propagation of forms.morph_class_id remains deferred to this phase, so generated form rows are not yet foreign-keyed to morph classes.

nodes.label: LexiconBrowseApp
nodes.rationale: Dictionary detail browse shows a join-at-read-time morph-class block and a selectable Wright section list. Morphology sidebar paradigm grids are unchanged. The June 28 lexicon checkpoint locks TUI v1 to browse only.
